Before you start

Wallet and network

Connect your wallet to BNB Smart Chain. Connecting a wallet does not transfer funds.

Funds

Keep the required USDT BEP-20 amount and about $5 in BNB for network fees.

Official access

Open the personal account only at app.atlas-system.io and check the address before confirming a transaction.

Choose Lockup Flow or Daily Flow

The flows differ in term, assistance schedule, amount limits and calculation rules.

Lockup Flow

One Claim becomes available after the selected term ends. The original Support Amount and calculated assistance are requested together.

Terms from 10 minutes to 30 days

Six tariffs for testing and regular cycles

Best first step: Contract Test

Daily Flow

The cycle lasts 200 days. Assistance can be requested daily under the Smart Contract rules; the original Support Amount is included in daily claims.

Core: $10–$2,000, 1.1% per day, +120% total

Elite: above $2,000, 1.3% per day, +160% total

Create a cycle

Open the form

In the personal account, select Provide Support.

Select a flow

Choose Lockup Flow or Daily Flow.

Select a tariff

Check the term, limits and calculation shown on screen.

Enter the amount

Specify the Support Amount in USDT.

Review the result

Check Expected Assistance, Delta and dates.

Confirm terms

Accept the terms and confirm that the action is voluntary.

Submit

Click the action button and review the wallet request.

Confirm in wallet

Verify the network, token, amount and BNB Gas.

Wait for status

The cycle appears in My Support Cycles after blockchain confirmation.

Track the cycle and its status

Open My Support Cycles. The card shows the amount, tariff, dates, calculated assistance and available actions.

Active

The cycle is running. Check its end date or the next daily assistance period.

Completed

The selected term has ended or the cycle has finished under the contract rules.

Use Operations History and the transaction link to verify the operation in BscScan.

Request assistance with Claim

Lockup Flow

After the term ends, request the available amount in one transaction.

Daily Flow

Request the available daily assistance according to the contract rules. The original support is included in daily claims.

Choose a cycle

Open My Support Cycles and select the required cycle.

Check the amount

Review the amount currently available for Claim.

Confirm

Click Claim, then confirm the transaction in your wallet.

What the platform fee applies to

The platform fee is 10% of Delta and Partner Rewards. It is not charged on the original Support Amount.

Blockchain network fees are separate and are paid in BNB.

Common issues

The cycle is not visible

Wait for blockchain confirmation, refresh the page and make sure the same wallet is connected.

Claim is unavailable

Check the term, cycle status, current available amount and contract rules.

The wallet requests approval

This is normally the first step that allows the contract to use the specified USDT amount.

The transaction failed

Check BNB Gas, network, wallet connection and transaction details in BscScan.

Continue learning

sources.title: Atlas System Knowledge Hub
sources.content:
Diagnostic route

What you see

First source to check

Typical next step

Wallet does not connect

MetaMask account, BSC and site permission

Reconnect the correct account

Transaction is Pending or Failed

Tx Hash on BscScan

Wait or correct the confirmed cause

Cycle or Claim is not shown

Account, cycle status and on-chain result

Refresh only after checking the hash

1. Run five checks before trying again

Start here even if the error message seems obvious. These checks prevent most duplicate transactions and wrong-account problems.

1. Official domain

Open Atlas from atlas-system.io and verify the complete address before connecting the wallet.

2. Correct MetaMask account

The account in MetaMask must be the same public address used for the relevant Atlas profile, Smart Cycle or Claim.

3. BNB Smart Chain

Atlas uses BNB Smart Chain (BSC). USDT used for an Atlas action must be on the BEP20 network.

4. Separate the two balances

USDT covers the selected Support Amount or other token amount.

BNB covers the BSC network gas fee.

Keeping approximately $5 in BNB is a practical starting reference, but the actual fee changes. Always review the estimate shown by MetaMask.

5. Previous Tx Hash

If an action was already submitted, check its Tx Hash on BscScan before clicking again. A slow Dashboard update is not a reason to create a duplicate transaction.

2. MetaMask does not connect or Atlas does not see the wallet

Common symptoms include an inactive Connect Wallet button, MetaMask not opening, Atlas continuing to ask for a connection or a different wallet address appearing in the Dashboard.

Check in this order

Confirm that the official MetaMask extension is installed and enabled.

Unlock MetaMask before pressing Connect Wallet.

Select the intended account.

Select BNB Smart Chain.

Check that app.atlas-system.io is allowed to connect to the account.

Allow the wallet pop-up if the browser blocked it.

Refresh the Atlas page and reconnect.

On a phone, open Atlas through the browser inside MetaMask Mobile when a normal mobile browser cannot pass the connection to the wallet.

The address changed after connection

Switching the selected MetaMask account changes the public address shown to Atlas. A different account may have a different profile, cycles and Partner Program data. Reconnect the original wallet before assuming that data is missing.

Atlas support does not need your Secret Recovery Phrase, private key or MetaMask password to diagnose a connection problem.

3. Wrong network, missing USDT or insufficient balance

Wrong network

Switch MetaMask to BNB Smart Chain, return to Atlas and refresh the page. Do not confirm an Atlas transaction on an unexplained network.

USDT is not visible

Check that the token is USDT on BEP20 and that the intended account is selected. If the token is hidden in MetaMask, add it only by using the official token contract reference.

Tokens sent through another network may not appear in Atlas. Recovery can be difficult or impossible, so verify the network and destination before every transfer.

Insufficient funds

Check USDT and BNB separately:

Message or symptom

Balance to check

Why

Support Amount is unavailable

USDT BEP20

The token amount is too low for the selected action.

Insufficient funds for gas

BNB

The wallet cannot pay the BSC network fee.

Amount is visible but Confirm fails

USDT, BNB and spending permission

One of the action requirements may still be missing.

Do not send tokens again until the original transfer, network and receiving address have been verified.

4. MetaMask rejects the request or shows an unclear error

MetaMask messages describe different stages. First identify whether the request was cancelled before submission or failed after being sent to the network.

User rejected / Cancelled

The request was cancelled in the wallet. If no Tx Hash was created, an on-chain transaction was normally not submitted. Return to Atlas, verify the values and start again only if the action is still required.

Insufficient funds for gas

Add enough BNB to the connected account for the estimated network fee. The gas fee is separate from the USDT Support Amount.

Cannot estimate gas / Execution reverted

The contract may reject the current conditions: the action may not yet be available, the amount or permission may be incorrect, or the state may have changed. Do not raise the fee blindly. Cancel the request and verify the cycle, amount, contract and previous transaction.

Unexpected or unreadable request

Select Reject. Check the official domain, the action that opened MetaMask and the contract address. If the purpose is still unclear, contact official support before confirming.

Connect, Sign, Approve and Confirm are different requests. See the Security guide before approving an action you do not recognise.

5. The transaction is Pending

What Pending means

The transaction has been submitted but does not yet have a final confirmed result. Pending does not by itself mean that funds are lost.

What to do

Copy the Tx Hash from MetaMask or Atlas operation history.

Open it on the official BscScan website.

Confirm that the network is BNB Smart Chain and the sender is the expected wallet.

Wait for a final Success or Failed status.

Refresh Atlas only after the on-chain status is clear.

What not to do

Do not create another Smart Cycle while the first creation transaction is Pending.

Do not press Claim repeatedly while the first Claim is Pending.

Do not assume that closing the browser cancels a submitted transaction.

Speed Up or Cancel may be available in the wallet. Each option can create another on-chain action and require BNB gas. Use it only when the wallet offers it for that exact transaction and you understand the result.

6. The transaction Failed or cannot be found

Status: Failed

Check the following before trying again:

enough BNB for gas;

the selected BNB Smart Chain network;

enough USDT for the action;

the intended account;

the official Atlas contract address;

the error or contract message shown by BscScan.

A failed transaction may still consume a BNB network fee because validators processed the attempted execution. Correct the identified cause before resubmitting.

Tx Hash is not found on BscScan

Confirm that the link opens the BSC explorer, not an explorer for another network.

Copy the complete Tx Hash again.

Check whether MetaMask shows the operation as submitted.

Wait briefly and refresh BscScan once.

If no Tx Hash was created, the action may have been rejected, only signed as a message or never submitted. If MetaMask shows a hash but BscScan still cannot find it, send that hash and a screenshot to support.

7. A Smart Cycle is missing or shows the wrong status

Check the wallet first

Confirm that Atlas is connected to the address that created the cycle. A different MetaMask account displays different activity.

Then check the creation transaction

BscScan result

What it means

Next step

Pending

Creation is not final

Wait; do not create a duplicate cycle.

Failed

The cycle was not created by that transaction

Correct the confirmed cause before retrying.

Success

The contract call executed

Refresh the Dashboard and verify the contract and token transfer.

If BscScan shows Success for the official contract but the cycle is still absent after the Dashboard refreshes, contact support with the wallet address and Tx Hash.

A Dashboard delay is not evidence that the cycle or funds are lost. Use the public on-chain record to establish what happened first.

8. Claim is unavailable, Pending or Failed

The Claim button is missing

Check:

the connected MetaMask account;

BNB Smart Chain;

the Smart Cycle status and completion time;

whether the interface shows an available amount;

whether a previous Claim is already Pending;

the cycle and contract data on BscScan.

Claim appears only when it is available under the selected Smart Cycle rules. A completed calendar period alone does not replace the current contract state displayed by Atlas.

Claim is Pending

Open the Tx Hash on BscScan and wait for a final result. Do not send another Claim while the first transaction is Pending.

Claim Failed

Check BNB gas, the network, the connected account, Claim availability and the error shown by the contract or BscScan. Retry only after the reason has been corrected.

Which asset pays the fee?

The standard BSC gas fee is paid in BNB. If the connected wallet supports Gas Station or a similar USDT gas feature, the wallet shows the available payment method and exact fee before Confirm. This network fee is separate from any Atlas Platform Fee.

No legitimate support agent needs an extra transfer, seed phrase or private key to “unlock” Claim.

9. Dashboard balance or history is delayed

Three interfaces can show different views of the same activity.

BscScan

Shows the public transaction status, sender, contract interaction, token transfers and network fee.

MetaMask

Shows assets and activity for the currently selected public address. A hidden token or different selected account can make a balance appear different.

Atlas Dashboard

Displays Atlas activity and processed contract data. The interface may update after the blockchain transaction has already reached Success.

Verification order

Confirm the public wallet address.

Check the Tx Hash and Status on BscScan.

Review BEP-20 Token Transfers and the amount.

Refresh the Personal Dashboard.

If on-chain Success is not reflected, send the evidence to support.

10. Stop and do not repeat the action

Select Reject or Cancel and stop if:

MetaMask opened without an action you initiated;

the website domain or contract address does not match an official reference;

the wallet request is unreadable or does not match the selected action;

the previous transaction is still Pending;

the wallet or Secret Recovery Phrase may be compromised;

someone asks for a transfer to “verify the wallet” or “unlock Claim”.

Save the public evidence, open Atlas manually through atlas-system.io and use an official support channel. For wallet compromise, follow the separate Security guide immediately.

11. Contact support with a complete diagnostic packet

Support can investigate faster when the first message contains the public technical facts.

Include

public wallet address;

Tx Hash;

BNB Smart Chain;

the Atlas page, section and action;

date and approximate time;

expected result and what actually happened;

screenshot of the error with secret information removed.

Never include

Secret Recovery Phrase or seed phrase;

private key;

MetaMask password;

access or verification codes;

complete device backups or remote access.

Support can review the wallet address, network, hash, transaction status, MetaMask message and Dashboard display. Support cannot cancel a confirmed blockchain transaction or restore a Secret Recovery Phrase.

Copyable message template

Wallet: 0x…Network: BNB Smart ChainAtlas section/action: …Tx Hash: 0x… / not createdDate and time: …Expected: …Actual result or error: …

12. Quick symptom reference

What you see

Check first

Do not do

Wallet not connected

MetaMask, account, BSC and site permission

Never enter a seed phrase.

Wrong network

BNB Smart Chain

Do not confirm on an unexplained network.

Insufficient funds

USDT amount and BNB gas separately

Do not confuse the two balances.

Pending

Tx Hash on BscScan

Do not create a duplicate action.

Failed

Gas, balance, network and contract condition

Do not repeat without identifying the cause.

Cycle missing

Account, creation Tx Hash and Dashboard sync

Do not immediately create a second cycle.

Claim missing

Cycle status, term and available amount

Never pay to “unlock” Claim.

Dashboard delay

On-chain status and Token Transfers

Do not treat an interface delay as proof of loss.

One rule to remember: establish the on-chain status first, then decide whether to wait, correct the cause or contact support.

Back to top

Verified update timeline

Data & Transparency guides expanded

Use as confirmation

Contract or transaction record on BscScan

Official Atlas communication linking to the source

Do not treat as confirmation

Screenshot without a source URL

Private message from “support”

Unverified community post

Promised date not present on the official site

Request to sign or pay to “activate” an update

What to do after an update

Read

Check the complete note, not only its headline.

Verify

Open the linked official source directly.

Never share keys or approve unknown transactions.
